postings.title: Machine Learning Engineer
postings.text:
Machine Learning Engineer
Brightleaf Retail | Chicago, IL | Hybrid

About the role:
Brightleaf Retail is a (fictional) organisation building tools for demand forecasting. As a Machine Learning Engineer you will work with a small cross-functional team and see your work used in decisions every week.

Responsibilities:
- Design, train and evaluate models for demand forecasting
- Build data and feature pipelines that are reproducible
- Improve latency, cost and reliability of inference services
- Run experiments and report results honestly

Requirements:
- 3+ years of relevant experience
- Python for data work (Pandas, notebooks, scripting)
- Solid grounding in Machine Learning (supervised and unsupervised methods)
- PyTorch for model development and training
- Docker for packaging and shipping services
- Strong SQL skills: joins, window functions and CTEs on large tables
- Experience with model deployment and serving models in production
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to have:
- AWS experience (S3, EC2, IAM, managed ML services)
- MLflow or similar experiment tracking
- Kubernetes for orchestrating training and serving workloads
